title: tritonia longiflora
intro: Tritonia longiflora, commonly known as "Queen of the Mountain" or "River Lily", is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tritonia longiflora include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
